guidedSteps.title: Accept the admin invite
guidedSteps.instruction: Open the app invite email sent to the admin address and set the password.

guidedSteps.title: Sign in once
guidedSteps.instruction: Open the deployed app URL and sign in once so the first login completes activation.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Detected_Objects
unsupported.detail: Objects in uploaded images are no longer labelled automatically.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.External_Record
unsupported.detail: The link to the other product is stored as text or an external reference until a connection is authorized.
unsupported.workaround: Ask the person who owns the external account to authorize the matching connection during migration; otherwise keep the value as text and complete the lookup after launch.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Extracted_Terms
unsupported.detail: Keywords are no longer extracted automatically when a record is submitted.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Forecast
unsupported.detail: The AI-predicted value is not filled automatically in the generated app.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Old_Crm_Record
unsupported.detail: The link to the old customer-record system is kept as a reference number.
unsupported.workaround: Ask the person who owns the external account to authorize the matching connection during migration; otherwise keep the value as text and complete the lookup after launch.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Old_Crm_Reference
unsupported.detail: The link to the old customer-record system is kept as its display text.
unsupported.workaround: Ask the person who owns the external account to authorize the matching connection during migration; otherwise keep the value as text and complete the lookup after launch.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Shelf_Code
unsupported.detail: The code value is stored as text; the code image is not rendered in the generated app.
unsupported.workaround: Enter or paste the code value into the generated text field, or add a reviewed scanning flow if the device workflow is required.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Site_Location
unsupported.detail: There is no separate map-location field; coordinates travel inside the address field instead.
unsupported.workaround: Capture the needed address or location in the supported address fields instead of a separate location field.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Text_From_Image
unsupported.detail: Text is no longer read out of uploaded images automatically.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

unsupported.name: Artifact_Intake.Tone_Result
unsupported.detail: Sentiment is no longer scored automatically when a record is submitted.
unsupported.workaround: Keep the AI-filled value out of the automatic form, or add a reviewed post-submit enrichment step before go-live.

verification: Run the guided data load, then compare each migrated table count with the source export count.
When automated record verification is available, run it to compare row counts and checksums and keep the result with the migration files.
Check one parent row and its related child or lookup rows before sign-off.

goLiveChecklist: Complete guided step: Accept the admin invite.
Complete guided step: Sign in once.
Load the source data and confirm every table count matches the source count.
Run record verification when it is available, then keep the counts/checksum report with the migration files.
Sign in as one user in each role and open the pages and reports that role should see.
Submit one test record through each converted form and confirm it appears in the expected report.
Promote the reviewed project to Production, switch business links, and keep Creator read-only until final sign-off.
